text.1_Introduction to the Laws of the Prohib: And now we shall clarify, with the aid of HASHEM, that which we knew above in the beginning of the introduction—specifically, how many curses he accepts upon himself, whomever doesn’t guard himself from this evil trait [of Lashon Hara].
